Back in the East — at a familiar spot, East Coast Park — for Singapore’s first Paralympic Day. Great to see so many Singaporeans coming together to celebrate our para-athletes, and the grit, determination and resilience they show in sport and in life. We have made steady progress towards a more inclusive Singapore. We will keep removing barriers and creating more opportunities for persons with disabilities to participate fully and contribute. To our para-athletes heading to the Asian Para Games: all the very best. Singapore will be cheering you on! 🇸🇬 (📸: MDDI Photos by Sean Koh) Singapore National Paralympic Council; Low Yen Ling
